title: WHEN STYLE BREAKS SAFETY: DEFENDING LLMS AGAINST SUPERFICIAL STYLE ALIGNMENT
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking the safety of LLMs against malicious queries and jailbreak attacks. Since safety alignment is the process of ensuring models adhere to ethical guidelines and avoid generating harmful content (e.g., chemical warfare instructions or inciting hatred), the paper directly deals with the evaluation of ethical boundaries in AI.
